freeze.deploymentScope: local-dev fixture (isolated; no production systems, no live provider accounts, no production mutations) — recorded separately from simulation outcomes per the charter

fourAdoptionOutputs.label: Technical full-switch eligibility
fourAdoptionOutputs.rule: no veto AND all applicable journeys discoverable+completable AND no missing-capability reason codes AND no blocker reason codes

fourAdoptionOutputs.label: Simulated stated willingness to switch completely
fourAdoptionOutputs.rule: no veto AND technical-full-switch-eligible AND weighted score >= FULL_SWITCH_THRESHOLD (65)

fourAdoptionOutputs.label: Main-interface eligibility
fourAdoptionOutputs.rule: no veto AND >= 80% of applicable journeys can start/be supervised from UNiCOM AND no main-interface-blocking reason codes

fourAdoptionOutputs.label: Simulated stated willingness to use as main interface
fourAdoptionOutputs.rule: no veto AND main-interface-eligible AND weighted score >= MAIN_INTERFACE_THRESHOLD (55)

releaseGateChecklist.gate: 100% matrix capabilities tested for GUI discoverability
releaseGateChecklist.evidence: zero-orphan feature map 132/132 against the real portfolio (W3-010/W3-012 tests)
outcomeCounts across baseline+holdout: fail=0, blocked=0; no critical-failure vetoes in any adoption decision
every project result and failure carries a journey-evidence record pointer; reconciliation drift 0 on both runs

releaseGateChecklist.gate: Zero hidden-route-only features counted as present
releaseGateChecklist.evidence: routeOrigin=homepage on every record; deepLinkUsedForDiscovery=false (W3-009 pilot proofs + the driver tests)
196,800 baseline + 196,800 holdout evidence records; per-family evidence tables complete (19/19 families)

releaseGateChecklist.gate: No severe high-frequency GUI blocker without mitigation
releaseGateChecklist.evidence: the amended-2 failure list is EMPTY (zero blocked/absent/fail journeys across all 15,275 personas)
holdout outputs identical to the amended-2 baseline: a=15275, b=15275, c=15275, d=15275
four separate outputs with denominators, computed under the frozen w2-009:v1 contract
every willingness number carries "synthetic simulation estimate"

caveats: Fixture-level simulation: the drivers model visible-UI paths as deterministic interaction/checkpoint graphs over the real experience-plane surface contracts (no pixel rendering, no real latency).
The clean baseline and holdout do not exercise the failure/UNKNOWN/recovery dimension (the W3-009 failure-variants machinery exists for a follow-up resilience measurement).
Synthetic adoption numbers are model outputs, not human preference research; validation with consenting real professionals is required before any user-facing adoption claim.
